messages.title: OX Inbox is live
messages.body:
Paul, your OX Inbox is now working.

From today, every answer I give about the Abena Tay Foundation or your Chief of Staff role lands here automatically  on this app, on every device.

What to know:
 Gold edge + red dot = unread. Tap a message to read it.
 ' Mark all read' clears the badge. ' Clear read' tidies old items.
 Tap ' Allow notifications' once, then follow Setup Guide 8 for phone pop-ups.

Your move: open  First 30 Days and start Day 1.

messages.title: How delivery works
messages.body:
Delivery rule (exactly as you instructed):
 Foundation / CoS-role answers  sent here automatically.
 Everything else  stays in the computer chat unless you say "send to my inbox".

This inbox is plain text only  built for reading answers anywhere, anytime, even offline.

messages.title: TOMORROW WED 9 SEP - FOUNDER SITTING 1 (30 min)
messages.body:
Part 0: confirm the official programme register.

BRING: the printed Interview Pack (Part 0 table) OR the Register on your phone.
DO: read the P01-P10 table to Her Excellency - she marks Active / Paused / Finished.
